name: table
title: Table
description: Presentational table parts on utilities: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption, TableSortHeader, TableBulkBar and TablePager, each with render and a className that may be a function of its state, plus the frame's views, toolbar, index column, expanded detail, empty/error rows and pagination. No part holds state.
whenToUse: Use it to compose a table frame from parts while you keep the data and its state. For sorting, filtering, paging and selection worked out for you use Data table.

parts.name: FilterToken
parts.description: A filter as a token: `field op value`, pressed to edit, with a remove cell. Inside a Toolbar it is a group of two toolbar items (one Tab stop for the row); elsewhere, two cells.

parts.name: TableBulkBar
parts.description: The bulk bar: the selected count (floods yellow while rows are selected), its scope, then the actions. Changes to it are announced politely.

props.name: count
props.description: how many rows are selected; 0 empties the bar (its count goes quiet)

props.name: scope
props.description: what the selection covers ("3 of 64 on this page"), and the ways to widen or narrow it

parts.name: TableCaption
parts.description: The table's caption: its name, read before its rows. Hide it with `className="kl-sr"` when a heading already shows the name.

parts.name: TableCell
parts.description: A body cell. To make it the row's header, render it as one: `render={<th scope="row" />}`.

props.name: align
props.description: "end" for figures: aligned to the end, with tabular numerals

parts.name: TableDetail
parts.description: Expanded detail. UNFOLDS from the row's bottom keyline; the row never moves. The parent row's index cell spans this row (rowSpan=2 while `presence.mounted`), so object and detail share one index cell. The caller holds the presence: `const presence = useDetailPresence(open)`.

parts.name: TableExpandCell
parts.description: The expand toggle column. `header` renders the column's header cell (labelled, empty); with neither, an empty cell keeps the column in a row that has no detail.

parts.name: TableFrame
parts.description: The table is one region frame. Views, toolbar, bulk bar, the grid and the pager are rows stacked inside it.

props.name: align
props.description: "end" for a column of figures: the label aligns with the numbers' edge

parts.name: TableIndexCell
parts.description: Index cell: selection checkbox + row code. Floods yellow from the press point when the row is selected.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.type: (checked: boolean, eventDetails: { reason: "none"; event: Event; cancel: () => void; allowPropagation: () => void; isCanceled: boolean; isPropagationAllowed: boolean; trigger: Element | undefined; }) => void
props.description: the new value; `eventDetails` is Base UI's checkbox change details (its `event` carries Shift)

parts.name: TableLoadingRows
parts.description: Rows standing in while data loads: hidden from assistive technology (the frame says it is busy).

parts.name: TablePager
parts.description: The pager row: cells for the range, the page and the page buttons.

parts.name: TablePagination
parts.description: Range + previous / page / next as cells of the pager. `page` is 0-based. While data is not ready, pass `total={null}`: the range and page count show "–" and the buttons are disabled (no stale numbers).

props.name: children
props.description: Fills the cell between the range and the buttons, e.g. <ToastDock />.

props.name: expanded
props.description: writes data-expanded: its detail row is open under it, so its cells end on a full keyline

props.name: selected
props.description: writes data-selected: the row's cells take the selected fill

parts.name: TableScroll
parts.description: The grid's scroller: a Keyline Scroll Area with both bars (wide tables scroll sideways inside their frame, never the page); the header cells stick to its viewport.

parts.name: TableSearch
parts.description: A search field as a cell of the toolbar. `className`, `ref` and the input's props go to the input.

props.name: cellClassName
props.description: classes for the cell around the input; `className` goes to the input

props.name: label
props.description: the field's name, read but not shown

parts.name: TableSortHeader
parts.description: A sortable column header. The whole header cell is the button; aria-sort sits on the <th>. The direction is a shape (▲ ascending, ▼ descending, both open when unsorted), and the sorted column's header carries an ink band on its bottom keyline. End-aligned (numeric) columns put the mark before the label, so the label stays on the numbers' edge. Use nextSort/sortOf from the collection lib for the cycle (ascending → descending → none). Several columns: pass `priority` (1-based) and `levels`. Each sorted header prints its place; `onSort` gets `{ additive }`, true when Shift was held, for nextSortList. ARIA allows aria-sort on one header at a time, so only the first level carries it; every sorted header's button also says its place ("sort 2 of 2, descending") in text.

props.name: levels
props.description: with several sort levels: how many columns sort

props.name: onSort
props.description: the header was pressed; `additive` is true when Shift was held (add the column as a further level)

props.name: priority
props.description: with several sort levels: this column's 1-based place

props.name: sort
props.description: the column's direction, or null when it does not sort the table

parts.name: TableState
parts.description: The table's empty or error row: an Empty (layout="cell") spanning the grid. Errors are announced.

parts.name: TableToolbar
parts.description: The filter row: search and pickers (Multiselect, DateRangePicker) side by side as cells. It is a named group, not a Toolbar, on purpose: a combobox and a picker own their arrow keys (to move in the text, to open and walk the list), so they cannot be items of a one-Tab-stop toolbar. Rows of plain commands and toggles are: the views row's end, the status row and the bulk bar's actions take a cell Toolbar, and a FilterToken inside a Toolbar becomes a pair of toolbar items.

parts.name: TableViews
parts.description: The table's view tabs (built on Tabs, so keyboard and aria come from Base UI), then an end slot.
